sections.heading: Our Process — Ingenium Diesel Timing Chain Repair

steps.title: Inspection & Diagnosis
steps.body: We run a full diagnostic check using JLR SDD/Pathfinder equipment to verify timing chain condition and identify any related issues.

steps.title: Access & Preparation
steps.body: Vehicle on lift. Engine covers, radiator, cooling fan, intercooler pipes, and ancillary belt removed. Oil and coolant drained.

steps.title: Engine Locked in Timed Position
steps.body: Using JLR-303-1625 locking tools, the engine is set to the timed position before any chain components are removed.

steps.title: Timing Chain Removal
steps.body: Crankshaft pulley removed, tensioner released, guide rails unbolted. Chain and sprockets removed.

steps.title: New Components Fitted
steps.body: New timing chain, tensioner, guide rails, and sprockets installed. Timing set to JLR specifications.

steps.title: Reassembly & Testing
steps.body: New seals and gaskets fitted. Front-end components reassembled. Fresh oil, filter, and coolant. Diagnostic verification and road test.

items.q: What does the Land Rover Ingenium diesel timing chain repair involve?
items.a: The repair involves accessing the timing chain at the front of the engine, removing the timing cover, releasing tension, and replacing the chain, tensioner, guide rails, and associated seals. The engine is set to the timed position using JLR-specific locking tools before any components are removed. We then reassemble with new gaskets, refill with fresh oil and coolant, and carry out diagnostic verification and a road test.

items.q: Which Land Rover models use the Ingenium diesel engine (AJ200D/AJ150D)?
items.a: The Ingenium AJ200D and AJ150D diesel engines are fitted in the [Discovery Sport](/discovery-sport-engines), [Range Rover Evoque](/range-rover-evoque-engines), [Range Rover Velar](/range-rover-velar-engines), [Defender](/defender-engines), and [Discovery](/discovery-engines) models. Specific variants include D150, D165, D180, D200, and D240.

items.q: What tools are required for Ingenium diesel timing chain replacement?
items.a: JLR timing locking kit (JLR-303-1625 or equivalent), camshaft holding and locking tools, crankshaft pulley holding tool, crankshaft pulley removal tools, fuel pump locking tool, torque wrench with angle-torque capability, and JLR diagnostic equipment (SDD/Pathfinder/TOPix). These are specialist tools that are not interchangeable with generic alternatives.

items.q: Why is the Ingenium diesel timing chain repair more complex than average?
items.a: The Ingenium diesel requires proprietary JLR timing locking tools (JLR-303-1625) which are not interchangeable with generic tools. The engine must be locked in the timed position before any components are removed — incorrect locking can result in valve-to-piston contact. The 4-cylinder has two camshafts requiring precise alignment. Additionally, the timing chain is located at the front of the engine (unlike some rear-mounted designs), but still requires significant disassembly of front-end components.
